props.textMarkdown:
Dear readers,

After years of listening to your feedback, we are excited to introduce **The Weekend Edition**: a slower, more thoughtful companion to our weekday coverage. Saturdays and Sundays will bring longer essays, deeper reporting, and stories that reward an unhurried read with a cup of coffee.

You will find three new regular sections waiting for you each weekend. We hope they become a place to pause, reflect, and discover something unexpected.

Thank you for reading, and for helping us shape what comes next.

Warmly,

The Editorial Team

props.text: One in-depth story each week, reported over months and written to be savored from start to finish.
Recipes, traditions, and conversations with the people who keep them alive in their own homes.
Short journeys close to home and far away, with practical tips for your next day out.
